name: kotlogramme
description: Lets an AI application read and, if you allow it, act on your own Telegram account.
long_description:
kotlogramme is a command-line Telegram client that also runs as an MCP server. By default it is read only: it lists chats, reads and searches messages, lists contacts and members, and waits for new messages. Raise the access level to read-write to send, edit, forward, react and pin, or to full to also delete, remove and block people, change admin rights and end sessions. Anything beyond read-only acts as you and reaches real people.

Before first use, sign in once in a terminal with the same executable: 'kotlogramme login --phone +<number>' (the file is in this extension's folder, or download it from the releases page). The server cannot ask for the login code itself. API id and hash come from https://my.telegram.org.

api_id.title: Telegram API id
api_id.description: The api_id from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).

access.title: Access level
access.description: read-only (default), read-write (also sends and edits) or full (also deletes, removes and blocks).
